lines.en: I creep along the ground

lines.zh: 我的身子只有半只箱子大
lines.en: My body is half a crate wide
My six legs shuffle forward
I crawl out of a puddle
I slip with every step
I circle a stone
My feelers test the way first
I drag my soft body along
I crawl over wet sand
I head toward the village
I squeeze through the fence gap
My shell clicks softly
I crawl along the wall base
I squeeze through a stone gap
I go with the run of the water
I leave a track in wet clay
I roll myself up small
My gills move in the water
I lie still and listen
My feelers sway back and forth
I wait for something to come near
I am still wet
I cannot tell what you think
Sand clings to my shell
I slowly unfold
I do not stir at all
My eyes sit on either side
I flatten myself down
I tremble slightly
I listen to the tide's beat
You look much bigger than me
I raise my eyes to you
My feelers reach toward you
I wonder if I can bite you
I shrink back into your shadow
I slide around to your side

lines.zh: 你脚边那块湿沙归我了
lines.en: The wet sand by your feet is mine now
I open my mouthparts
Do not move, I am looking
I edge away from your shadow
I curl my body up tight
A seam splits in my shell
The hit rolls me over
The pain swells inside my soft body
Water seeps from the wound
I press flat and freeze
My feelers pull in
I tremble backwards
I can still keep crawling
Small as I am, of course

lines.zh: 我闻到咸味之外的东西
lines.en: I smell something besides salt
What you hold is not from the sea
I lean in and sniff
That thing is far too dry
I lick it once and back off
I do not eat such soft things
That smell is unknown to me
Lower it a little
I circle it once
Living is still better
You knock me rolling
I bounce off you
My shell gives a brittle knock
I am flipped over
You are harder than shore stone
I hurry to right myself

lines.zh: 我的触须像被打了个结
lines.en: My tentacles feel tied in a knot
I shrink and spring back
You stepped on my feeler
I hurry back into the puddle
There are many of us in the sea
The tide gathers us together
We do not choose
I follow the bigger ones
We lay our eggs in water
This whole shore belongs to the sea
I only want to reach the land
We do not question each other
I hear a call far off
We all face the same way
I grip it in my claws
This weighs more than I do
I drag it two steps
I try a bite
It falls into my mouth
I roll into the water with it
I will carry this back

lines.zh: 我把它压在自己的身下
lines.en: I press it beneath me
I cannot tell if it is food
I shove it onto the bank
You are within my reach
I coil my soft body
I am going to leap
Your heel is nearest to me
I mean to bite this time
My feelers all point at you
A small target, and I am quick
I choose your ankle
Your smell is very close
I am ready to spring
I follow you along the ground
Lift your foot and I jump
I wait for you to bend down
I hide beside your feet
I leap again
I am hard to find when you turn
I land and rise again
Your boot grazes me
I keep changing position
I shift to your other side
I leap and bite you
I hang on your trouser leg
I spring in from the side
My mouthparts dig in
I bite and roll away
I throw my body at you
A shallow bite, but eager
My claws scrape your skin
I latch onto your calf
I bite and let go
Something surfaces in the shallows
I climb from water onto sand
A small shadow joins the shore
My shell shows first
I shake the grit off my shell
Water drains out between my six legs
This place belongs to the sea now
I slip out of the kelp
I land still dripping
I lift my head to the land
Fire turns my shell brittle
I roll twice when I land

lines.zh: 水太深，我控制不住往下
lines.en: Too deep, and I cannot hold level
The blast flings me away
An arrow pins me to the ground
Magic sears my soft flesh
Hunger stiffens my legs
Wet as I am, lightning hits hardest
I fall where there is not even water
